trigger_condition: An in-flight intake or ownership clock has consumed 90 percent or more of its target at the decision instant.
business_reasoning: An imminent or actual service-promise breach outranks the lead's own commercial evidence, because the bank has already made the commitment.

trigger_condition: An escalation-response clock (SLA-10) was raised strictly before the decision instant and is still in flight at it.
business_reasoning: An open escalation means a manager has already been engaged; the lead must be worked first.

trigger_condition: Branch or partner referral (CH-BRN or CH-PTR) with recorded contact consent and explicitly stated credit interest.
business_reasoning: A named referral with explicit credit intent is the highest-quality introduction the hypothetical process receives, and the referrer expects a fast response.
An unresolved duplicate must not compete for attention; scoring it would double-count the same prospect.
An incomplete record cannot be worked and its score would rest on absent evidence.

trigger_condition: Lead status at the decision is NURTURING.
business_reasoning: A nurturing lead has an agreed future contact date and must not displace leads that are workable now.

trigger_condition: Priority eligibility is invalid, merged, withdrawn, terminal, manual_review or not_yet_routable.
business_reasoning: Ineligible leads must never receive a score so that the priority queue contains only workable leads.
